UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public player profile for the Games Hub.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

GameScore.title: GameScore
GameScore.description: A recorded game score entry for Basketball or Ultimate Anime Quiz.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player who achieved this score.

playerName.description: Player name displayed on the leaderboard.

score.description: Numeric score achieved in the session.

streak.description: Best consecutive streak achieved in the session.

won.description: Whether the player won/passed the challenge.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when score was recorded.

GuestbookComment.title: GuestbookComment
GuestbookComment.description: A public visitor comment in the Guestbook stored in Firestore.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the comment author.

authorName.description: Display name shown alongside the comment.

message.description: The visitor comment or encouragement message.

badge.description: Selected topic badge for the comment.

likesCount.description: Number of likes received by this comment.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the comment was created.

GuestbookLike.title: GuestbookLike
GuestbookLike.description: Per-user atomic like marker for a guestbook comment.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who liked the comment.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the like was created.

/users/{userId}.description: Player profiles indexed by Firebase Auth UID.

/game_scores/{scoreId}.description: Global game score records and leaderboard entries.

/guestbook_comments/{commentId}.description: Public visitor guestbook comments and encouragement messages.

/guestbook_comments/{commentId}/likes/{u.description: Per-user atomic like records ensuring one like per verified user per comment.
